description: emailHeaders: Subject, From, To, Date as Name: value lines, a blank line, then the body. Headers the message lacks (CC, BCC) have no line (tikajs-5qkk).

input.text:
Date: Tue, 01 Oct 2024 12:34:56 -0500
From: sender@example.com
To: recipient@example.com
Subject: Example RFC 822 Email
Message-ID: <1@example.com>

This is an RFC 822 email message.
